fields.name: query
fields.note: The adaptogen or botanical research question (e.g. 'What is the evidence for Ashwagandha reducing cortisol?', 'Profile Rhodiola rosea safety and interactions', 'Compare adaptogenic mushrooms for cognitive function').

fields.name: domains
fields.note: Optional. Which knowledge domains to search: 'species', 'traditional_medicine', 'phytochemistry', 'evidence', 'safety', 'genomics'. If omitted, searches all 7 domains.

fields.name: include_supply_chain
fields.note: Optional. If true, also invoke supply_chain_oracle for pricing and sourcing data on the botanicals identified. Default false.
